name: MCP Office
description: Local-first MCP servers for Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). Governed tool calls over Excel, PowerPoint, and Word via Python stdio. Requires Windows. COM-backed tools (PDF export, live recalculation, tracked changes) additionally require Microsoft Office. No hosted tier — runs on your machine.

excelmcp.description: Excel MCP server — 60+ tools for reading, writing, formatting, and exporting Excel workbooks

environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_ALLOWLIST_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directory roots allowed for file access (required)

environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_ENABLE_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable write operations

environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_ENABLE_COM
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to activate COM-backed tools: recalculate_workbook, export_as_pdf, hydrate_template, pivot_table, and evaluate_formula(live=True). Windows-only — requires pywin32 and Microsoft Excel.

pptmcp.description: PowerPoint MCP server — 48 tools for building, editing, reviewing, and exporting presentations

environmentVariables.name: PPT_ALLOWLIST_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directory roots allowed for file access (required)

environmentVariables.name: PPT_ENABLE_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable write operations

environmentVariables.name: PPT_ENABLE_COM
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to activate COM-backed tools: export_slide, export_deck, run_slide_show, recalculate_charts, and export_changed_slides_only. Windows-only — requires pywin32 and Microsoft PowerPoint.

wordmcp.description: Word MCP server — 51 tools for document creation, structured editing, tracked changes, and export

environmentVariables.name: WORD_ALLOWLIST_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directory roots allowed for file access (required)

environmentVariables.name: WORD_ENABLE_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable write operations

environmentVariables.name: WORD_ENABLE_COM
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to activate COM-backed tools: manage_tracked_changes and export_document (PDF/HTML). Windows-only — requires pywin32 and Microsoft Word.
